race.comment: KIREINA MARUBRAH (6) is an honest mare who did not find much off the top at Launceston 11 days ago when finishing at the rear of a 4-horse field, albeit less than 2 lengths from the winner. She slips back in class, and can make amends. Follow your money. AL MAXIMUS (3) was fifth in a 5-horse field last start when caught out in a sprint home at Launceston a month ago. He is better than that, and is worth another chance, especially with the aid of a 2kg claim. FIORENTE DE LEGEND (2) may not win often, but she is very consistent, and she looks set for another profitable season, finishing in the money both starts this season. She loves it here, and can take this out. GEE GEES ME BOY (1) is another very consistent gelding who will have the blinkers on again after a stout third at Launceston last time out. Each way. THISISMYTURF (5) has yet to win on this track, but has been placed 4 times from 10 starts. A 4kg claim is a help, and he should be included on all combos to be safe.
